summary: Shopify connection status contradicts itself
evidence: The global header says Shopify connected: aurora-outfitters.myshopify.com, while the integrations card says Shopify not connected and offers Connect Shopify.
recommendation: Use one canonical Shopify status source across AppHeader and SyncStatusCard; show connected domain, last sync, webhook state, and reconnect action only when needed.

summary: Expected product routes return not-found states
evidence: Requested audit routes are missing even though the product uses equivalent concepts at /upload, /history, /chargebacks, and /settings/audit-trail.
recommendation: Create redirects or canonical routes for expected IA names, then replace default not-found pages with branded recovery pages.

summary: Claims table shows customer UUIDs instead of analyst-friendly identity
evidence: Customer cells display truncated profile IDs, forcing analysts to click before understanding who the claim belongs to.
recommendation: Join customer profile name, masked email, risk score, and watchlist state into the claims query; make the customer cell two-line and clickable.

summary: Claims table loses key columns at 1024px
evidence: At 1024px the right side of the table is clipped, hiding SLA, evidence, at-risk value, updated time, and actions.
recommendation: Add a responsive table strategy: sticky first/action columns, horizontal-scroll affordance, column priority, and compact density for laptop/tablet widths.

summary: Claim review panel displays incorrect or missing customer context
evidence: The claim review route showed No customer email on file for a seeded profile with an email, and cross-merchant count did not match the profile evidence.
recommendation: Load customer identity, email, risk score, and cross-merchant summary from the same profile source used by the customer dossier; add empty-state guards only when values are truly absent.

summary: Login form is visually labeled but not programmatically labeled
evidence: Playwright could not resolve the email/password fields by label, and the login page has no visible H1.
recommendation: Associate labels with inputs using htmlFor/id, add an H1 such as Sign in to Unauth, and ensure focus/error states meet WCAG contrast.

summary: Warm beige and brown dominate too many surfaces
evidence: Canvas, table backgrounds, filter fills, cards, charts, and primary actions all sit in similar warm tones, flattening hierarchy and making the product feel brown/beige SaaS.
recommendation: Move to neutral enterprise surfaces with warm graphite text and controlled copper accents; reserve brown/rust for brand, primary action, active nav, and limited emphasis.

summary: Design tokens are duplicated and internally inconsistent
evidence: globals.css defines overlapping brand, spec, shadcn, surface, ink, text, severity, and landing token systems; --text-muted is cool blue-grey while the canvas is warm paper.
recommendation: Create a single app token layer for canvas/surface/border/text/action/risk/status and migrate components away from legacy aliases over time.

summary: Reports do not feel executive-grade or board-ready
evidence: The match-rate chart is sparse, uses a single angular copper path, and gives little context for why the metric matters.
recommendation: Introduce a report template with KPI narrative, trend deltas, resolution funnel, value-at-risk split, export menu, and premium chart styling with neutral grids.

summary: Information architecture labels conflict
evidence: The same area is called Customers, Clusters, Investigations, Chargebacks, and Evidence packages in different contexts; settings side nav labels Audit trail as Data & privacy.
recommendation: Define canonical nouns: Dashboard, Inbox, New audit, Audit history, Reports, Customers, Claims, Watchlist, Evidence packages, Settings. Use those consistently in nav, routes, breadcrumbs, and headings.

summary: Raw enum and technical copy leaks into the UI
evidence: Examples include view_customer in audit trail, Conf 0.84 in profile badges, filename-like audit rows, and metadata key/value dumps.
recommendation: Add presentation label maps for actions, confidence, status, and metadata; show technical values only behind details disclosure or copy buttons.

summary: Claims table values wrap awkwardly and reduce scan speed
evidence: Order references and evidence package references wrap into multiple lines, disrupting row rhythm.
recommendation: Use fixed-width ID cells with mono text, truncation, copy affordance, and secondary metadata below the main row value.

summary: Claim workflow forms feel long and default-like
evidence: Selects, textareas, and disabled save buttons use similar beige surfaces and borders; the main action state is not clearly connected to claim selection.
recommendation: Split claim creation, decision, evidence, and response into clear task panels; use stronger section headers, helper text, disabled-state explanations, and compact field styling.

summary: Claim review requires too much manual form work before outcome actions unlock
evidence: The analyst must save a claim before recording outcome/evidence, and the timeline says Select a claim to view its audit history while already in a claim review context.
recommendation: Default to the highest-priority active claim, preselect the order when only one duplicate exists, and keep outcome/evidence/timeline anchored to the selected claim.

summary: Dashboard is not clearly queue-first
evidence: The top of the dashboard shows KPI cards and charts, but the next analyst action is less obvious than it is in the inbox.
recommendation: Lead with a priority work queue: overdue claims, high-risk open claims, awaiting evidence, Shopify sync issues, and one-click continue review.

summary: Pages rely on too many bordered boxes
evidence: Customer profile, claim review, settings, and reports often stack full cards inside larger framed sections, creating admin-template density without a strong hierarchy.
recommendation: Use full-width page bands, unframed grids, and single-level cards only for repeated items or task panels. Reduce nested borders and use spacing/type for grouping.

summary: Sidebar brand and merchant display feel cramped
evidence: The top-left brand area renders as Unauth .x aurora... and truncates the merchant in a way that feels accidental.
recommendation: Separate product wordmark from merchant switcher; use a compact merchant button with tooltip/full domain and environment badge.

summary: Status, risk, and action colors are not distinct enough
evidence: Rust, red, amber, and beige fills appear close together across active nav, primary actions, warnings, risk badges, and charts.
recommendation: Define distinct semantic palettes: rust for brand/action, red for critical fraud, amber for SLA warning, green for safe/legitimate, teal/slate for data/privacy info.

summary: Watchlist recent-appearance metric appears unreliable
evidence: Watchlisted customers show Appeared 30d 0 despite seeded recent watchlist and claim activity.
recommendation: Check watchlist appearance query and scope, then show the source of appearance counts with last seen, orders, claims, and merchant count.

summary: Upload flow wastes vertical space and has wrapping KPI copy
evidence: The dropzone dominates the screen, while the step label Flow Map -> Process wraps awkwardly.
recommendation: Compress the upload panel, move template/help content into a side rail, and make the import status strip fixed-height with short labels.

summary: Audit trail exposes raw metadata and actor fragments
evidence: Rows show actor IDs such as acde1e0f and raw key/value metadata, which reads like an internal admin log rather than a compliance-ready audit trail.
recommendation: Show actor name/email/role, human action label, affected object, before/after summary, timestamp, and expandable raw metadata.

summary: Evidence package list masks customer identity too aggressively
evidence: Customer email is reduced to a first-letter mask, which protects data but makes analyst triage harder when multiple packages are similar.
recommendation: Show customer display name plus masked email/domain, with full email behind permissioned reveal or copy action.

summary: Team controls need clearer permission and destructive-action hierarchy
evidence: Role selects and trash icons are visible across owner/pending/member rows without enough explanation of what can safely change.
recommendation: Separate pending invites from active members, disable owner role edits with explanation, and gate remove actions behind confirm copy.

summary: Audit history includes demo-like filenames and empty period values
evidence: Rows include raw CSV filenames and dashes in period, which lowers confidence during enterprise demos.
recommendation: Render human audit names, source labels, imported-by attribution, covered date range, and processing status. Keep raw filenames as secondary metadata.

summary: Some button labels are too system-oriented
evidence: Customer profile uses Compile signal data, which sounds like an internal process rather than an analyst action.
recommendation: Replace with action-oriented labels such as Review evidence, Open claim review, Export dossier, or Refresh signals depending on the actual behavior.

summary: Confidence/risk badges can conflict semantically
evidence: A profile can show risk 84 while also displaying confidence grade language that reads as B/Probable, creating uncertainty about whether the badge is risk or identity confidence.
recommendation: Separate fraud risk, identity confidence, and evidence confidence into distinct labels with tooltips and consistent grading language.

summary: Missing routes use default not-found experience
evidence: The not-found screenshots do not guide the analyst back to the correct Unauth workflow.
recommendation: Create branded not-found states with links to Dashboard, Inbox, New audit, Audit history, Claims, and Settings.

summary: Interaction states feel mostly static
evidence: Buttons, rows, tabs, and filters change state but have little tactile feedback or progressive disclosure polish.
recommendation: Add subtle 120-180ms transitions for row hover, filter open/close, panel reveal, and toast feedback while respecting prefers-reduced-motion.

summary: Icon usage is helpful but not yet systematic
evidence: Lucide icons appear in nav and settings, but table actions, statuses, and evidence categories rely mostly on text and color.
recommendation: Define icon mappings for SLA, evidence, Shopify sync, customer response, duplicate warning, and destructive actions; use tooltips for icon-only controls.

summary: Reports lack manager-ready export and explanation affordances
evidence: Only Export claims CSV is obvious, and the page does not explain what changed, why it matters, or how to report it upwards.
recommendation: Add export menu for claims CSV, outcomes CSV, PDF summary, and date-range comparison; include metric deltas and explanatory footnotes.

summary: Dedicated data privacy trust surface is missing
evidence: The footer and settings context imply privacy/data handling, but /settings/data-privacy returns not found.
recommendation: Create a data privacy page covering Shopify data scope, retention, DPA links, audit logging, data deletion, and role-based access.
